answer: Because the forge index is kept in the fable history, a repeat is caught as a duplicate, and the beacon audit republishes its digest each close. Running 139 keys as a result needs a fresh supply of prose indefinitely, which turns a one-off build into a permanent operating cost with no amortisation. Answer text is checked for similarity against the entire 12 epoch history rather than the current epoch alone, so a template that worked once cannot be reused later either.
